text: A股三大指数全线翻红，元件、CPO、零售、氦气等板块涨幅居前；全市场超3000股上涨，天孚通信涨近8%，中际旭创、新易盛跟涨
text_en: A-shares' three major indices all turned positive, with components, CPO, retail, helium and other sectors leading gains; over 3,000 stocks in the broader market rose, T&S Communications up nearly 8%, Zhongji Innolight and Eoptolink gaining in sympathy
